summary: English and Afaan Oromo first-party discovery found Ethiopia's official Addis e-Land cadastral portal and Ethio-NSDI, but no Bonsa Bota/Sidama local parcel registry or open parcel-vector endpoint. The current e-Land GeoServer WFS is Addis-configured; its bounded request around the preserved WUP point returned zero features and is not treated as evidence of citywide absence.
queryOutcomes: Both discovery queries, languages, outcomes, and actual first-party URLs are recorded verbatim in city-6702-bonsa-bota.json.
requestOutcomes: All executed public GET requests, current viewer/config inspection, WFS capabilities/schema inspection, bounded anonymous WFS request, and the default-TLS Ethio-NSDI failure are recorded in city-6702-bonsa-bota.json. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, private token, unsafe field, or TLS-verification bypass was used.
scopeLimits: The e-Land viewer and WFS metadata verified Addis-focused cadastral infrastructure only.
No Bonsa Bota/Sidama parcel geometry or stable native parcel identity was verified.
The zero-feature bounded WFS response is not evidence of citywide or countrywide parcel absence.
No exact-point hit/miss inference, map extent inference, or adapter qualification was made.

nativeFieldMapping.geometry: geometry (MultiPolygon; observed in Addis schema only)

geometryRetention.reason: No safe, verified Bonsa Bota native parcel geometry response was available.

uncertainty: Open local parcel coverage, native identity semantics, schema, CRS, service availability, and citywide completeness remain unverified; runtime integration is not admitted.
